datasets.name: NCSU SMS Phishing Data Releases
datasets.citation: Nahapetyan et al., 'On SMS Phishing Tactics and Infrastructure'

baseline_tfidf_logistic_regression.battery_impact: Negligible (<0.1 uJ / msg; suitable for continuous background NotificationListenerService)
baseline_tfidf_logistic_regression.multilingual_robsutness: Gracefully handles word loanwords and token n-grams; zero-shot Hinglish relies on phonetic and Latin keywords.

neural_dense_mlp.battery_impact: Moderate (15-20x energy per sample vs linear model)
neural_dense_mlp.multilingual_robsutness: Dense embeddings overfit to English token co-occurrences; higher out-of-vocabulary degradation on Hinglish.

selection_rationale: Baseline TF-IDF + Platt-calibrated Logistic Regression selected due to 20x lower latency (0.14ms), sub-100KB footprint, zero battery drain in background service, and higher token/substring resilience.
